verdict.rationale: Logseq's export docs say the whole graph can be exported as JSON, standard Markdown, OPML, EDN, Roam JSON and HTML. Community users confirm local data they can sync and back up via GitHub. There are caveats: one user reports the generated Markdown files add indentation that breaks compatibility with other tools like Obsidian, and the new DB version reportedly stops keeping notes as plain Markdown files, so ownership leans on export rather than native storage. Missing for 10: published schema/specification documentation for the JSON/EDN export formats, clean interoperable native Markdown storage in the DB version, independent hands-on verification of export fidelity.
